source: Universitaetsbibliothek Erlangen-Nuernberg, Briefsammlung des Christoph Jacob Trew (Trew Briefsammlung), via bavarikon / api.digitale-sammlungen.de IIIF image API v2

pages.note: recto: ordinary Latin letter (dateline 'Hamburgi', addressed 'Amplissime Vir Dominorum', signed 'Hamburgi... A.o.R. A ne.im. A.d.n.Rbb'). No cipher content visible at native resolution.

verso/address side: address block ('Volckamero, Fuernehmen Practico und Medicinae Doctorn zu Nuernberg'), wax seal, and, top left rotated 90 degrees, three separate key blocks (plain alphabet / substitute-letter tables, no drawn glyphs, no running ciphertext).

pages.native_region: 0,0,1450,2200 (native pixels, top-left quadrant), rotated 270 degrees for upright reading
pages.note: the three key blocks at readable resolution: (1) a 5x5-ish grid 'Kaqnl/lbrnu/mcson' over 'oeqqp/pfxrh'; (2) the 24-letter Latin alphabet (no j/v) 'abcdefghiklm/nopqrstuwxyz' over two rows of substitute letters 'qgeob'/'ptagbez'; (3) a small grid 'agntom/b.onpn/ci.pwqo'. All three are systematic alphabet-to-symbol tables, not an enciphered message -- no clear-text crib, no word-length running block anywhere on either page.
